Either way my daughter was very disappointed, we have to return these but her event is in just 2 days. Thinking about ordering a Women's size 5 BUT... if they actually send me a Women's true size 5 (not a Men's size 5!) it will be too small! Since when is Adidas unable to get their sizing right???
